body:
# S11 done: onboarding, plan generator, diagnostic, Today, coach

## Commits (on claude/naadi-shared)
- fe44ae6: all of S11 (generator, migration 0013 on 0012 with a single head, API, coach graph and cron, web, tests).
- 7191c3c: Today's cards-due count equals the Cards screen's `due_now` (new visible cards included); Review links in-app to /cards.
- Included in fe44ae6: a fix to S03's first-sign-in race in `auth_routes._ensure_profile`. A concurrent insert after the statement snapshot made /api/me return 500; it now re-selects. Regression test: tests/plan/test_plan_db.py::test_concurrent_first_requests_all_see_the_profile. seg03 notified (20261116T222748).

## Plan CSV, byte for byte
- tests/plan/test_generator.py::test_reference_inputs_reproduce_the_csv_byte_for_byte: `to_csv(generate(template, start=2026-11-16, exam=2027-01-15, W=Mon–Sun, H=10)) == data/study_plan_step1_60d.csv` bytes (CRLF, hours printed `8` not `8.0`, `—` for an empty qbank cell).
- tests/plan/test_plan_db.py::test_template_rows_round_trip_through_the_database: the same result starting from the seeded `plan_template_days` rows.
- Property tests: every n in 21..180 with all 7 days, and all 127 weekday sets × 6 spans. They check that day 1, every assessment day and the rest day on the exam eve are kept, that order is kept, that every date is a study weekday inside the range, and that week and weekday are derived from the date. Too few days → structured 422 `too_few_study_days`, and the profile is still saved.

## Tests
- Local, on the rebased tree, with the lead's gate (`pnpm -s lint && pnpm -s typecheck && pnpm -s test && pytest -m "not live and not db"`): exit 0. pytest 811; vitest web 253, shared 125, ink 66, ui 27.
- db suite on a fresh stack (real 0011/0012/0013): 364 passed. Plan/coach db tests (16) include the diagnostic on S09's timed blocks, /api/today numbers equal to direct SQL, RLS, the coach pass, and Today's cards due equal to /api/cards/stats.
- e2e smoke (today.spec + shell.spec; webkit-ipad-portrait, webkit-ipad-landscape, webkit-phone-390, chromium-laptop-1440), `--retries=0`: 84/84 twice in a row. Also learn/search/qbank on webkit-ipad-portrait and webkit-phone-390: 61 passed, 1 skipped.

## CI
Run 127 (https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions/runs/43980568767, sha 4b23e2b, contains fe44ae6 and 7191c3c). My own runs 43976265071 and 43978192252 were cancelled by later pushes; that happened before 4a173bb gave every push its own run.
- lint / typecheck / unit / drift / build: green. db integration: green.
- e2e chromium: today.spec 42/42 and shell.spec 84/84 passed. The job is red only on S12b's ink-sync.spec (3 tests × 6 projects); reported in 20261117T000652.
- e2e webkit: today 42/42, shell 84/84 passed. The job is red on 2 one-project failures in S06's learn.spec (:387 on phone-412, :357 on laptop-1440). Both are a WebKit "Fetch API cannot load /api/public-config due to access control checks" page error, which is how WebKit reports a fetch aborted by navigation. Not S11 code.
- e2e firefox: cancelled before its summary, with no failures up to that point; today 35 and shell 70 passed.

## Checklist (docs/REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md)
- Copy: every string is a ui_copy key in config/app_config.yaml and REQUIRED_UI_COPY_KEYS (152 today/onboarding/coach keys; S03's unused Today keys removed); defaults regenerated; src/today added to noHardcodedCopy.test.ts. The server sends structured fields and error codes. Rules-based coach suggestions carry facts only and are worded from `coach.rules.<kind>.*`. LLM suggestions are assistant-authored and shown in violet.
- One lime CTA per view (e2e limeCount == 1 on Today). Status is never colour alone: chips carry words (Now/Done/Planned/Skipped/Outside Naadi/Added by Naadi), weak systems show amber plus the word "weak", thin data shows "not enough data", and selected chips have a check icon.
- Phone 390/412: no overflow (expectNoHorizontalOverflow in every state).
- No dead links: "Full plan" is absent until S16; "Ask Naadi" shows only with the assistant flag; Review shows only with the cards flag and due > 0; outside resources are chips, never links; the diagnostic step appears only when S09's timed blocks exist and qbank_timed is on.
- No keyboard shortcuts added.
- Leaks and privacy: Today and the diagnostic never read or return answers. Resuming an open block uses `attempts.chosen` counts only. Diagnostic questions come only from non-mock questions. The coach payload is numbers and taxonomy labels; the PrivacyContext is loaded by llm.py for user_id; a db test asserts the medical school never reaches the prompt.
- RLS: study_plans select only; study_plan_days update (status, score_notes) only; coach_suggestions update (status) only. All four _own policies are in the same migration, plus the RLS coverage test, the live_check list and check (46 tables), and a single head.
- CSP: an e2e against the APP_ENV=prod server renders Today and /welcome with zero console errors.
- Free models only: one structured-role call per student per night (one retry) through llm.py with purpose `job`; BudgetExhausted stops model calls for the rest of the pass and the remaining students get rules. LLM calls are mocked in tests.
- e2e waits for in-flight requests and fonts before reloading or going offline.

## Screenshots (iPad portrait, iPad landscape, phone 390)
test-results/screens/11/: welcome-empty, welcome-filled, welcome-too-short, diagnostic-start, today-diagnostic, today-first-day, today-coach, today-coach-why, today-ticked, today-offline (×3 viewports each, plus chromium-laptop-1440 for those states). Compared with design/Onboarding, Main and PhoneToday.

## Decisions
- Reference inputs are taken from the CSV (dates, 7 days, 10 h). The rest day always falls on the exam eve, even when that is not a study weekday. Extra days are inserted as copies of the weekly Review row, spread evenly and taking the neighbouring phase. Short plans drop Review rows, then Mixed review rows (evenly), then merge same-chapter topic days (lightest pair first), and only then different-chapter adjacent topic days. The last step is needed for n near 21.
- Item durations come from app_config.plan.item_minutes (questions at 90 s plus review, fixed sizes for cards, admin and extra); there are no clock times. Questions items link to Naadi's Qbank builder (the Naadi equivalent). UWorld, NBME, AnKing and Mehlman get an "Outside Naadi" chip. "Book Mock Exam" → ref_type mock.
- Readiness counts a system as covered with at least 1 first attempt; it is shown at ≥ 40 answered and ≥ 50 % of the blueprint weight. By-system bars use all graded attempts in the last 14 days.
- Every shared e2e role is onboarded once when its session is minted (e2e/session.ts), so existing specs that open / still land on Today. today.spec mints its own users for each project.
- Today's primary action order: open block (or diagnostic) → the first actionable plan item (read, Qbank, weak-spot, misses, cards) → last reading → Practice.
- The ui_copy cap is now 2000 (S09) on shared; my earlier 1000 was superseded.
- Analytics split agreed with seg09 (20261116T215440): analytics/student.py and blueprint.py are S11's; queries.py and results are S09's.
